episodes.title: Occult Rituals in the Epstein Files.
episodes.description:
The Jeffrey Epstein story is usually told as a tale of blackmail and intelligence work. But the symbolism hidden in his properties, and the details buried in the DOJ files, point to a 600-year-old occult template that keeps resurfacing in every century with a new frontman.

Epstein's purchases and records lead straight to the most famous occultist of the 20th century, Aleister Crowley. And Crowley's ideas go back even further, to the Lesser Key of Solomon, an occult text that is centuries older.

This video makes the case that Epstein was running something far stranger than a blackmail operation. He was the doorman for a network that sits above governments and institutional power. The design of his temple reveals what he was actually building.

I'll break down the symbolism of Zorro Ranch, the temple on Little Saint James, the sacred objects Epstein collected from religious traditions around the world, and the two books he bought in 2007. All of it points back to occultism.

From there, I trace the same pattern through 600 years of history. I look at three cases, in 15th century France, 17th century Paris, and 20th century Belgium, where powerful figures ran nearly identical operations. Every time, the investigation was shut down the moment it reached the people at the top. And every time, the public got the same story; a lone bad actor with a few accomplices.

This is an analytical look at the symbols, the architecture, and the documented record. Every claim is sourced, and the full citation list is linked below.

📜 Full sources and the written companion piece: https://www.tayjmcm.com/p/occult-rituals-in-the-epstein-files
